params.body:
Everything built on the workbench since main, on one branch, so main is the place to start.

What it adds:

- Rule book: every rule on a step of a flow, with the words a person is asked in; the organisation and who acts in every lane; mail (M1 to M3, L6); opening a client's account (A1 to A4); the agent a person talks to is the Principal AI.
- `rulebook draft`: a change to one flow, compiled and tested without touching the book. A draft becomes our rule book only when the key holders sign its version.
- Knowledge: what Bextrust is as things, links and sourced statements, compiled into one version and refused when it does not hold together.
- Simulation: our company on one machine with one person on a real phone; the Principal AI answers the asks people make, reaching our systems only through the gate.

Checked: `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass.

Where the running simulation differs from this branch:

- The gate still runs the rule book of before 16 November, which names the agent `crm-agent`. The move to this book waits for a second key holder on its policy and grant; `SIM_AGENT` keeps the old name until then.
- The accounts rules A1 to A4 are approved as a version but the gate does not decide by them yet.
params.title: Handover: the rule book with mail and accounts, the knowledge folder and the Principal AI
